themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to jobs, housing, and social services. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, Sweden, France, and the UK, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Sverigedemokraterna, Rassemblement National, and Reform UK leading the charge. The policies often include stricter immigration controls and welfare reforms.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Advocates for 'national priority' in housing, jobs, and social services, particularly in Andalusia and Castilla y León.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies favoring Italian citizens over immigrants, with debates on regional autonomy and welfare reforms.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Promotes welfare reforms prioritizing Swedish citizens, including stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring French citizens in jobs and social services, with a focus on immigration restrictions.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pushes for stricter immigration policies and welfare reforms prioritizing British citizens.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces declining approval ratings and growing internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza. Disputes over judicial appointments, economic policies, and political alliances have created rifts, particularly with key figures like Patricia Bullrich. This theme is mirrored in Spain and the US, where far-right leaders also grapple with internal divisions and declining public support.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, and the UK are making significant gains in local and regional elections. These gains reflect broader dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift toward nationalist and anti-immigration policies. The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) in Germany, Vox in Spain, and Reform UK in the UK are notable examples.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Poland, Hungary, the UK, France, Italy, and Argentina are experiencing significant internal divisions. These conflicts often revolve around leadership disputes, policy disagreements, and ideological shifts. For example, Poland's Prawo i Sprawiedliwość (PiS) and Hungary's Fidesz face leadership challenges, while Italy's Lega and France's Rassemblement National grapple with ideological splits.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in the US, Argentina, Italy, Poland, and France are reacting to ongoing Middle East conflicts, particularly the US-Iran tensions and the Israel-Palestine situation. These parties often frame their responses in terms of national security, immigration, and geopolitical alliances. For example, the US MAGA movement and Poland's PiS emphasize strong military responses, while Italy's Fratelli d'Italia and France's Rassemblement National focus on immigration controls.
